# VibeCrew

> A free, open-source Claude Code plugin that transforms Claude Code into an autonomous vibe-coding operating system.

VibeCrew orchestrates multiple Claude Code sessions, manages the full software development lifecycle, and enables non-technical users to build production-grade SaaS applications.

## Key Capabilities

- **14 Specialized AI Agents** — Opus for planning/research/code, Haiku for routing/commands, Sonnet for documentation
- **Two-Tier Workflow** — Foundation phase (architecture, design, tech stack) then iterative feature development (plan, design, code, test, review, docs)
- **Phase Gate Enforcement** — Bash hooks prevent code writes until architecture decisions are complete
- **Vibe Score System** — Quantified code quality scoring (0-130) with automatic deductions and bonuses
- **33+ Slash Commands** — `/setup`, `/plan-features`, `/run-backlog`, `/check`, `/wrap`, `/review`, `/tdd`, and more
- **25 MCP Servers** — 3 bundled (Context7, Chrome DevTools, Playwright) + 22 in registry, added after TDR
- **Self-Improving** — Performance Coach proposes permanent CLAUDE.md rule mutations based on anti-patterns
- **Cost Tracking** — Session and daily cost guardrails with automatic notifications
- **User Profiles** — 7-dimension personalization (code literacy, autonomy, verbosity, risk tolerance, etc.)
- **Gamification** — Achievements, progression, and session scoring

## Installation

Requires Git 2.30+, Node.js 18+, and `jq`. Install by cloning the plugin into your project's `.claude/plugins/` directory.
